# Lanson Live API — Documentation for AI assistants

Last updated: 2026-11-08

> LansonAI is the Voice Context Layer for Live Speech. Lanson Live API is its
> developer-facing speech capability. Each entry links to
> the canonical page served by the docs site.
>
> Base URL: https://docs.lansonai.com
> Raw Markdown for any page: https://docs.lansonai.com/raw/docs/<path>.md
> OpenAPI spec (Recorded API): https://audio.lansonai.com/openapi.json
>
> Design principle: Human-readable + Agent-readable + Schema-accurate.
> Pages are organized by "what a developer wants to build", not by internal
> technology names. Technology concepts (Trinity Engine, StableStream™, LiveFinal™) are
> explained only after a developer has chosen a capability.

## Brand and technology

- LansonAI: company and platform — Voice Context Layer for Live Speech.
- Lanson Live: speech model brand; model name `lanson-live-1`. Lanson Live API exposes the capability to developers, without a model-selection step.
- Trinity Engine: core engine for multi-model orchestration, speech processing, and context coordination. Not a selectable model.
- StableStream™: core technology for continuous, stable, readable live text. Not an event type.
- LiveFinal™: progressive correction and segment-finalization mechanism. The public Realtime endpoint currently delivers a single completed result per successfully processed utterance, with optional refinement applied before delivery.
- Lanson Live App: end-user live speech product; distinct from Lanson Live API. Other product lines include Lanson Flow, Lanson Reception, and Lanson Podcast.
- HTTP `model` is an optional compatibility field; omit it in new examples. If a client requires a name, use `lanson-live-1`. Existing request values need not change. Do not expose provider/worker names as public model brands.
- Preserve endpoint URLs, request field names, and event identifiers exactly as documented. Do not fabricate partial/revision/final event types or treat manual flush as an implemented finalization command.

## AI-Native Transcription

Real-time speech. AI-reviewed. Final text.

- Dual-model live loop: Acoustic speech recognition (ASR) is only the first signal. Before any utterance is delivered, a separate reasoning model (LLM) with full conversation context reviews every word in real time.
- StableStream™ holds speech inside a bounded segment window rather than emitting flickering provisional drafts, giving the reasoning layer time and context to verify each utterance.
- LiveFinal™ delivers one completed, speaker-faithful transcript event—resolving domain terms and phonetic ambiguities without paraphrasing.
- Configurable segment buffers (2–4s, 5–10s, 12s+) let developers tune update cadence against intra-segment context.

- [What is AI-native Transcription](/docs/ai-native-transcription): Real-time speech, AI-reviewed, final text. What AI-native transcription is — full-conversation review before delivery.
- [StableStream™](/docs/ai-native-transcription/stablestream): What StableStream™ is — stable, completed utterances instead of flickering drafts; scenario presets for segment duration.
- [Context-aware Refinement](/docs/ai-native-transcription/context-aware-refinement): What context-aware refinement is — conversational context improving recognition while preserving speaker intent.
- [Conversation Context](/docs/ai-native-transcription/conversation-context): What conversation context is — context carried across utterances instead of isolated audio fragments.
- [LiveFinal™](/docs/ai-native-transcription/livefinal): What LiveFinal™ is — review before the final handoff, one completed result per utterance.
- [AI-ready Transcripts](/docs/ai-native-transcription/ai-ready-transcripts): What AI-ready transcripts are — structured events designed for downstream AI agents and workflows.

- [Get started with Lanson Live API](/docs/start/quickstart): API key → Realtime WebSocket → audio → completed text; Segment and Batch paths follow.
- [Authentication](/docs/start/authentication): API Key, server-side usage, browser-side security (short-lived session token, HMAC), secret management.
- [Choose an API](/docs/start/choose-an-api): Realtime, Segment, and Batch workflows of Lanson Live API; not model choices.
- [Pricing](/docs/start/pricing): Lanson Live API audio-minute rates, optional refinement/translation, and prepaid credits; separate from App subscriptions. Live source: https://audio.lansonai.com/v1/pricing.

## Realtime Voice Context

- [Realtime Streaming](/docs/realtime): Lanson Live API Realtime inputs, completed text, optional correction/translation, and technology boundaries.
- [Realtime Quickstart](/docs/realtime/quickstart): Python, Node.js, and browser connection examples; supply real PCM audio instead of placeholders.
- [Connection Lifecycle](/docs/realtime/connection-lifecycle): Connect → configure → stream audio → receive events → close/reconnect; state machine, timeouts, idle/session limits.
- [Audio Input](/docs/realtime/audio-input): PCM, sample rate, channels, chunk size, supported formats, chunk/latency tradeoffs.
- [Transcript Lifecycle](/docs/realtime/transcript-lifecycle): VAD → recognition → optional refinement → one completed event per successful utterance. No partial or later-revision protocol on this endpoint.
- [Realtime Translation](/docs/realtime/realtime-translation): Source/translation mapping, language config, language switching, latency behavior.
- [Session Configuration](/docs/realtime/session-configuration): language and session-level options; config timing (connect vs runtime).
- [Handling Interruptions & Silence](/docs/realtime/interruptions-silence): silence, pause, session continuation, VAD / end-of-speech behavior.

## Recorded Speech

- [Recorded Audio](/docs/recorded): Recorded vs Realtime, when to use which, current capability boundary.
- [Transcribe Audio](/docs/recorded/transcribe-audio): Upload file / URL → transcript; sync vs async (webhook / poll); file size / format limits.
- [Timestamps & Speakers](/docs/recorded/timestamps-speakers): Segment timestamps, precision limits, and speaker-diarization availability.
- [Subtitles](/docs/recorded/subtitles): SRT / VTT generation; segmentation rules; relation to timestamps.
- [Translation](/docs/recorded/translation): File-level translation.
- [Structured Results](/docs/recorded/structured-results): Current result envelope and limitations of summary, chapters, and action items.

## Concepts

- [Voice Context Layer](/docs/concepts): What Voice Context is; vs raw STT output; why live speech needs a context layer.
- [Stable vs. Partial Text](/docs/ai-native-transcription/stablestream): Why realtime speech text ≠ token stream; partial vs stable essence; don't self-manufacture jitter.
- [StableStream™](/docs/ai-native-transcription/stablestream): Stable, readable output behavior and its public completed-event contract; not a selectable model or accuracy guarantee.
- [Context-Aware Processing](/docs/ai-native-transcription/context-aware-refinement): How context affects correction / stabilization; behavior, no internal implementation leakage.
- [Latency Model](/docs/concepts/latency): network / recognition / stabilization / translation latency; measurement and reduction.
- [Live Translation](/docs/realtime/realtime-translation): language config, language switching, latency behavior.
- [Trinity Engine](/docs/concepts/trinity-engine): Shared technology foundation — architecture / concept page.
- [LiveFinal™](/docs/ai-native-transcription/livefinal): Progressive correction and segment finalization; exact public events, feature availability, and limits of the current endpoint.

## Guides

- [Browser Live Captions](/docs/guides): Browser live captions and other runnable recipes.
- [Server-side Streaming](/docs/guides/server-side-streaming): Backend pushes audio stream; connection topology; auth / token management.
- [Build a Stable Caption UI](/docs/guides/stable-caption-ui): Render completed segments, order by utterance index, and handle uncertainty without partial-text replacement logic.
- [Build Live Translation](/docs/guides/live-translation): Bilingual / translated caption UI; side-by-side render; language-switch UI.
- [Save a Transcript](/docs/guides/save-transcript): Persist delivered utterances and merge them; no session-wide final event is implied.
- [Reconnect a Live Session](/docs/guides/reconnection): Network disconnect, retry, resume design; backoff strategy; session continuation boundaries.
- [Client-VAD Segments](/docs/guides/client-vad-segments): Client-side VAD speech segment transcription.

## API Reference

- [Lanson Live API](/docs/api-reference): Base URL, REST / WebSocket, versioning (`/v1/...`); per-endpoint template.
- [Realtime API](/docs/api-reference/realtime-api): WebSocket endpoint; connection URL and query params; auth; message format (JSON).
- [Client Messages](/docs/api-reference/client-messages): All client → Lanson messages; field schemas.
- [Server Events](/docs/api-reference/server-events): Exact Lanson Live API event types, correction metadata, translation association, and ordering.
- [Segment Transcription](/docs/api-reference/segment-transcription): `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` — synchronous multipart client-VAD transcription.
- [Batch Jobs](/docs/api-reference/batch-jobs): Async batch transcription jobs — enqueue and poll.
- [Languages & Models](/docs/api-reference/languages): Lanson Live model brand (`lanson-live-1`), language behavior, and optional HTTP compatibility field; no model selection required.
- [Language Detection](/docs/api-reference/language-detection): `POST /v1/audio/language-detection` — detect language of a short clip (≤20s) without transcription; use when the language is unknown.
- [Errors](/docs/api-reference/errors): HTTP error codes; WebSocket error events; payload schema; common errors and triage.
- [Rate Limits](/docs/api-reference/rate-limits): Concurrency, requests, session duration; per-plan limits; over-limit behavior.
- [Admin API](/docs/api-reference/admin): Key provisioning, revocation, plan catalog (internal operators and dashboards only).

- [Latency Best Practices](/docs/production/latency-best-practices): Audio chunks, connection reuse, region; end-to-end latency reduction.

## Notes for coding agents

- The Realtime WebSocket API contract is defined in `/docs/api-reference/client-messages` and `/docs/api-reference/server-events`.
- The transcript state machine contract is defined in `/docs/realtime/transcript-lifecycle` and `/docs/ai-native-transcription/stablestream`.
- LiveFinal™ behavior and availability are described in `/docs/ai-native-transcription/livefinal`. `transcript.revision` is currently `0`; correction occurs before the single completed event when refinement is enabled. There is no separate public correction event or session-wide final event on the documented Realtime endpoint.
- Raw Markdown for any page: `https://docs.lansonai.com/raw/docs/<path>.md` (e.g. `/raw/docs/start/quickstart.md`).
- The Recorded API OpenAPI spec at `https://audio.lansonai.com/openapi.json` is the schema-accurate source for recorded endpoints.
